context: Two cafe friends compare weekend plans and book clubs
purpose: Teach: ブリッジ/チャンピオン/屋敷/湿度/飲料/近郊/ハリー/群馬

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今週末、群馬の温泉に行こうかなって。湿度が高い東京から逃げたくて。
lines.en: Thinking about hitting the hot springs in Gunma this weekend. Wanna escape humid Tokyo.
lines.style: Soft, dreamy delivery with a tired sigh on humid

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいなあ。私は近郊のカフェ巡りで読書会だよ。今月の課題本、ハリーポッターの再読会なの。
lines.en: Lovely. I'm doing cafe-hopping nearby for book club. This month's pick is a Harry Potter reread.
lines.style: Warm, slightly excited tone with a girlish lilt on Harry

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 再読いいね。あの古い屋敷の描写、何度読んでも鳥肌立つもん。
lines.en: Rereads are great. Those old mansion descriptions give me goosebumps every time.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, lowering voice on goosebumps for effect

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でしょ。今回は三大魔法学校対抗試合の巻だから、誰がチャンピオンになるかで盛り上がりそう。
lines.en: Right? This time it's the Triwizard Tournament volume, so we'll get fired up over who becomes champion.
lines.style: Bright, anticipatory cadence rising on champion with a small giggle

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの店でもやろうよ。コーヒーや炭酸飲料そろえとくし、奥にカードゲームのブリッジ用テーブルもあるよ。
lines.en: Let's host one at my shop. I'll stock coffee and soda, and there's even a bridge card-game table in the back.
lines.style: Friendly, inviting pitch with a hospitable upward inflection at end

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本気?じゃあ群馬から戻った週末でどう?みんなびっくりするよ。
lines.en: Seriously? Then how about the weekend after you're back from Gunma? Everyone'll be stunned.
lines.style: Surprised then delighted, voice climbing with genuine excitement throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 決まり。温泉で英気養って、戻ったらじっくり語り尽くそう。
lines.en: Done deal. I'll recharge at the hot springs, then we'll really sit and talk it all out.
lines.style: Satisfied, conspiratorial close with a confident little laugh at end
